1. SYSTEM ARCHITECTURE — WHAT THE SYSTEM IS
-------------------------------------------
Vistamations is NOT a project, NOT a folder, NOT a workspace. It is a SYSTEM.

    Vistamations System (C:\vistamations-music)
    │
    ├── LOCAL SUB-SYSTEM
    │   └── Local Environment (Docker + Windows)
    │       ├── Docker stack: nginx (80), app:3000, Redis (6379), Prometheus (9090)
    │       ├── OpenClaw Gateway (PID-based, port 18789)
    │       ├── 6 scheduled Windows tasks
    │       ├── 17 API routes (Express)
    │       ├── Static web pages & apps
    │       └── Pete's files: .vscode/pete/ (4-value ID)
    │
    └── CLOUD SUB-SYSTEM
        ├── Cloudflare Environment
        │   ├── D1 database: vistamations-agent-memory (AGENT_DB)
        │   ├── Worker: vistamations-agent-memory (agent memory API)
        │   ├── Worker: mya (Mya wizard + chat)
        │   ├── Worker: vistamations-home-bento (homepage)
        │   └── KV namespaces (deferred): HANDY_MAIL, SESSION, MYA
        │
        └── Google Cloud Environment
            ├── Project: vists-498322
            ├── Vertex AI: gemini-2.5-pro (global)
            ├── Gemini CLI (trusted workspace)
            └── ADC auth (application_default_credentials.json)

THREE ENVIRONMENTS TO DATE:
  1. Local Environment       (Windows/Docker — primary runtime)
  2. Cloudflare Environment  (Edge — Workers, D1, KV, domain routing)
  3. Google Cloud Environment (Vertex AI — model access)

2. WHAT THE SYSTEM CONTAINS
---------------------------
- 10 AI agents (Dominion I roster: AG001 Gordon through AG010 gem)
- Command Control dashboard (bento grid with live telemetry)
- Media Centre (8-agent grid, HTML5 video, playlist persistence)
- Command Portal (two-way Olivia message queue + agent replies)
- Mya (AI wizard + voice chat, /mya subdomain)
- Handy Mail (8-step envelope gate, Ed25519 signatures, scrypt hashing)
- PDF Toolkit (OCR, digital signature, budget calculator)
- Gem Chat (Gemini multimodal chat interface)
- Publications (auto-discovered RUN reports)
- Links (research link ingestion pipeline)
- Evidence Registry UI (v1 with ink-stamp animation)
- Clock (Wagga Wagga real-time with weather + 8-city world)
- vista-sec-water (API key vault + Gate Manager)
- Security module (rate limiting, nonce cache, capability issuance)

3. HOW AGENTS FIT INTO THE SYSTEM
----------------------------------
All 10 agents live inside the SYSTEM. Their mode files are in .kilo/modes/.
Their personas (where defined) are in personas/. They communicate through
the Olivia message queue (POST /olivia/respond) and report through the
Command Portal (command-portal.html). 

Agent reporting chain:
  Player → Merlin V.II (AG003) → Olivia (AG004) → Gordon (AG001)
      → Trinity (AG002) → Claw(AG005)/Big Brother(AG006)/Dee(AG007)/Stefi(AG008)
      → Terence (AG009), gem (AG010)

4. GIT BRANCH CLARIFICATION
----------------------------
The "evidence-registry" branch is NOT a separate system, NOT a separate
directory, NOT a feature. It IS the active working branch where ALL system
files live. The branch name came from an early session's commit title
("Evidence Registry v2") and stuck. All work since 2026-08-07 is on this
branch. The "main" branch contains only the initial commit and is dead.

You do NOT need to switch branches. You ARE on evidence-registry. That is
correct. The git branch is the SAME physical directory (C:\vistamations-music)
tracked on a named line of commits.

5. SYSTEM AIM & OBJECTIVES
--------------------------
The Vistamations System is an autonomous knowledge production operating system.
It governs research acquisition, publication, deployment, monitoring, and
archival via an AI agent network operating across local hardware (Local
Sub-System) and cloud infrastructure (Cloud Sub-System).

Immediate objectives:
  1. Complete agent personas (8 of 10 missing)
  2. Populate Redis + knowledge graph (both empty)
  3. Write a real agent dispatch daemon (agent-daemon.js is a build spec, not code)
  4. Establish test framework + CI/CD
  5. Wire Gemini daemon with ADC auth
  6. Build automated container rebuild (stale containers currently run old code)

6. GEM'S SPECIFIC MISSION (AG010)
----------------------------------
"To transform raw multi-track audio, visual assets, and unstructured human
concepts into structured, searchable metadata and high-fidelity, interactive
designs."

Resources: Local media files (MP3, WAV, M4A, MP4), Evidence Registry DOM-003,
Gemini 3.5 Flash via Vertex AI (vists-498322, ADC-configured).

Current blocker: Gemini auth is ADC-configured but daemon wiring is pending.
No live Gemini daemon runs yet. gem operates via manual Kilo session invocation.
